objectives.text: Choose a collection implementation from stated needs for duplicates, ordering, lookup by key and access pattern, and justify the choice
Justify ArrayList over LinkedList for indexed access and iteration using the operation costs the Java API documentation states
Pick LinkedHashMap, TreeMap or a sorted list when a result must keep insertion order or sorted order

minutes.basis: intake planning estimate under the new-course rule in authoring/docs/tools/validators.md (budget at least ceil(max(estimator P50, modeledWorstPath)), 15-minute ceiling, no day-pool shares).
